overview_description.description:
Papricut.com is an online platform that allows companies and individuals to book a photographer or videographer anywhere in the world. A photographer or videographer is sent to your event within a moment's notice. They edit the content the same day and content is delivered the same day with a choice with translations in any of the 3,000+ languages available. 

Papricut.com has 100,000+ photographers, videographers and translators and is the first platform of its kind to offer access to work opportunities for a niche group.
